He is listed at 6 feet 5 inches tall.
In a 2021 win over Virginia Tech, Gavin Bartholomew caught an 8-yard touchdown pass from Kenny Pickett.
Against Boston College in 2024, Gavin Bartholomew caught two touchdown passes.

# Pickett leads Pitt to 28-7 victory over Virginia Tech

* * *

By AP

Oct 16, 2021, 08:28 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

BLACKSBURG, Va. -- — [Kenny Pickett](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4240703/kenny-pickett) threw two touchdown passes and rushed for a score to lead Pittsburgh to a 28-7 victory over Virginia Tech on Saturday.

Pickett threw touchdown passes of 8 yards to [Gavin Bartholomew](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4708049/gavin-bartholomew) and 36 yards to [Jared Wayne](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4430681/jared-wayne) , and he scored on a 3-yard run — all in the first half — as the Panthers (5-1, 2-0 Atlantic Coast Conference) won their third straight game. Pittsburgh, which won in Blacksburg for the first time since 2015, moved into sole possession of first place in the ACC’s Coastal Division.
